properties.name: chari.baas.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for the Chari BaaS API, for example https://api.chari.ma.

properties.name: chari.baas.api-key
properties.description: API key sent as the Chari-Api-Key header to authenticate Chari BaaS HTTP requests.

properties.name: chari.baas.webhook-secret
properties.description: HMAC-SHA256 secret used to verify incoming Chari webhook signatures. If blank, signature verification is skipped.

properties.name: chari.baas.timeout-ms
properties.description: HTTP connection and read timeout in milliseconds.

properties.name: chari.baas.principal-agent-id
properties.description: Principal agent code sent as the code query parameter.

properties.name: chari.baas.principal-agent-rib
properties.description: Principal agent RIB used as the default bank account for Agent Principal operations.

properties.name: chari.baas.webhook.enabled
properties.description: Whether to auto-register the Chari webhook controller.

properties.name: chari.baas.webhook.path
properties.description: URL path that receives Chari webhook POST requests.

properties.name: chari.baas.audit.enabled
properties.description: Whether the client logs structured request and response audit entries.

properties.name: chari.baas.audit.mask-sensitive
properties.description: Whether audit logs mask card PAN, CVV, PIN, and expiry values.
